theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (Rp : IMRep U (m + 1)) (R : ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 < R → closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ U → Rp.Represents S → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 R → S.boundary ω = 0) → ∃ t σ : ℝ, R / 4 < t ∧ t < R / 2 ∧ ∀ (β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (s : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ≤ s) → |∫ x in Rp.carrier ∩ ball 0 t, (Rp.mult x : ℝ) * Rp.orient x (exteriorDerivative (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]| ≤ σ * s
